operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are backtick-quoted in DDL; generated SQL must double-quote them (Roles, Users, Document_Structures, ...).
Mixed-case table names (Roles, Users, Document_Structures, Functional_Areas, Document_Sections_Images) — case-insensitive column lookup required.
Document_Structures and Functional_Areas have self-referential-looking parent_*_code columns but NO declared FK; they are plain VARCHAR(15) with values that happen to be codes (e.g. '1','6','8').
Document_Functional_Areas has NO primary key (pk=[]); upstream sample_fresh_primary_keys must handle empty PK (no dedup) and drop_unique_duplicates has nothing to drop.
Document_Sections_Images has composite PK (section_id, image_id) — composite-PK member gets max_l0=30 per spec 3.3.
All VARCHAR columns store text; INTEGER columns store integer — no storage/declared-type contradictions observed.

No NULLs anywhere (null_rate 0.0 on every column) despite several nullable columns; NOT NULL only on role_code, functional_area_description, document_structure_code, document_type_code, document_code, section_id, image_id.
Small tables (2–20 rows); original_values sampling of 5 with replacement will heavily repeat (Roles has 2 rows, Functional_Areas 3).
VARCHAR(15) PKs hold short numeric-looking strings ('1','5','6','8','9','217','349') — String fuzzer will add str(i±1) neighbours and contaminate.
user_login holds '0'/'1' (2 distinct) while user_name holds dotted names — String fuzzer treats both identically.
password holds 40-char hex hashes; image_url holds http URLs; section_title only 'after'/'before' — String fuzzer will not preserve these shapes.
No views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs in DDL; empty-clone creation is straightforward.
operator_ts_expectations: All VARCHAR columns dispatch to String fuzzer (charset a-zA-Z 0-9() plus contamination) — role_code, document_code, section_code, image_url, password all get random strings, destroying the numeric-code / URL / hex-hash shapes.

INTEGER columns (user_id, image_id, section_id, access_count, section_sequence) dispatch to Number fuzzer with scale=0, precision=0 → range [-1,1] plus ±1/±2 perturbation; access_count (1864..8208) and section_sequence (4510..9847) will be wildly implausible.
Number fuzzer's list_max quirk (overwrite with full-range max) means even with original values in the pool, fresh draws dominate the small [-1,1] range.
String fuzzer's int-like neighbour addition (str(i+1), str(i-1)) will produce plausible-looking codes for document_code/section_code but not for password/url.

FK role_code (Users→Roles), document_structure_code (Documents→Document_Structures), document_code (Document_Functional_Areas, Document_Sections→Documents), functional_area_code (DFA→Functional_Areas), section_id/image_id (DSI→Document_Sections/Images) are filled from parent's final values — good referential integrity, but parent PKs are random strings so children inherit random strings.

Document_Functional_Areas has no PK → no dedup → many duplicate (document_code, functional_area_code) pairs; original has 15 rows / 11 distinct document_code, so duplicates are plausible but TS will over-produce them.
Document_Sections_Images composite PK dedup keeps first occurrence; with random section_id/image_id from parents, collisions are rare so ~n rows survive.

Self-referential-looking parent_document_structure_code / parent_functional_area_code are NOT FKs → filled by String fuzzer independently, breaking the tree structure (parent codes won't match any document_structure_code).
Expected FN drivers: queries filtering access_count > 1000, section_sequence ranges, or LIKE 'http%' / hex-pattern passwords will find no matching rows in TS instances.

Expected FP drivers: queries relying on the tree (parent_document_structure_code = document_structure_code) or on document_type_code ∈ {Book,Paper,Advertisement,CV} will see random strings and may spuriously match/differ.
Small parent tables (Roles=2, Functional_Areas=3) mean FK children collapse onto few values; joins produce tiny results, amplifying result_eq sensitivity.
